_comment: Copy to ~/.jarvis/config.json and edit. Every key is optional —
the defaults work without this file at all. Unknown keys are ignored,
so a config written by a newer version still boots.
_comment_mcp: Remote MCP servers. The API connects to these server-side, so their
tools show up without any integration code here. Find servers at
an MCP server is third-party code with access to whatever it is given.
Prefer an env var over a literal token: this file is easy to commit by
accident, and a token pasted here ends up in a backup somewhere.
_comment_shell: Extra binaries the shell tool may run. Interpreters are excluded by
default because allowing one is allowing arbitrary code — add python3
only when the agent runs inside a container.
_comment_verify: Fresh-context review passes after each answer. 0 (off) is right for
Opus 5, which verifies its own work. Set 1 when running a smaller model.
